excluded: networking, BLE, GPIO, I2C, storage, or other peripheral expansion

required_workloads.required_outcome: every full queue rejects the newest event, drains in order, and accepts the next round
every timed-out completion is stale and the single bounded slot is reusable
every second completion is duplicate and the following correlation succeeds
the complete bounded sample emits ordered min, p50, p95, and maximum values
each real unreachable trap is followed by a successful common-Wasm execution
each native fault latches reset-required and a simulated reset restores a clean fixture
the explicit host pressure reservation is released with zero tracked retained bytes

scope: sustained bounded pressure, recovery, measurement, and opt-in named-board reruns
